pnpm.comment: Security overrides — patched transitive versions. protobufjs ships to the client via onnxruntime-web (Embedding Explorer). esbuild/vite are dev-tooling (dev-server advisories, not shipped to visitors) pinned to patched within the same major. NOTE: js-yaml is intentionally NOT overridden — forcing >=4.2.0 breaks astro's `import yaml from 'js-yaml'` default import; astro 6.4.8 already resolves a safe js-yaml, and the advisory is a build-time DoS only.
